coverage.evidence: Test tau 0.745 against rule-derived gold; tau 0.848 against independent expert consensus over 6 sets.

corrections_from_stage4: Grounding lookup keyed by bare finding id; previously keyed by the full pipe-delimited line, which never matched and produced NaN for every arm.
Raw model output stored at 4000 characters; 300 truncated mid-JSON and broke reconstruction.
Sampling parameters unset during greedy decoding to remove spurious warnings.
limitations: Test evaluation covers 60 of 150 instances; CIs are clustered by resource to account for reuse.
Single training seed; run-to-run variance not measured.
Rank stability 0.68 indicates residual positional sensitivity constraining autonomous use.
Grounding precision 0.595 implies a 40% hallucination rate in explanations.
Expert study used 2 raters over 45 findings; treat as indicative.

Inter-rater concordance (W = 0.984) is well above the 0.4-0.7 typically reported for vulnerability prioritisation, likely reflecting the prescriptive SSVC rubric and the clear separation of indicator profiles in the sample. It should not be read as evidence that cloud risk prioritisation is generally unambiguous.
Discovery is IaC-based; runtime SDK enumeration not implemented.
